record.question: Which of the following drug is not considered a psychotropic substance?
record.explanation: Official final key: B — Ramelteon. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 9, printed Q79. Source limitation: The term may mean a psychoactive drug generally or a substance controlled under NDPS law; the stem does not specify the classification scheme. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
